QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #8
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Cliff for a pair of warm mittens, and asked me to do it for him. Here's the man that constantly works for the kids in a warm, loving manner... I better really work hard at this!\n\n#i4001181# #t4001181# #b#c4001181# / 1
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Cliff for a pair of warm mittens, and asked me to do it for him.  I couldn't stand Keol, but I worked hard at it for the sake of Mr. Cliff. Even so, Keol gave me a hard time about the mittens. What is wrong with this guy?

0.0: It's you again. I wasn't aware of this last time, but when I tried to sell the item you made last time in the market, I heard an earful from Moren. I have to hand it to you for constantly proving the adage 'ignorance is a bliss.'
0.1: I was thinking of having you take care of this, but I am not so sure about that anymore. Are you sure you can handle this? This is a very important order, so if you even make one tiny mistake on this, I am gonig to be all over you. Are you sure you can handle this?

yes.0: Of course, you are the perfect combination of ignorance, chutzpah, and unfound confidence. You are simply amazing... anyway, this request is from Cliff of Happyville. He's one of those people that are universally loved for his neverending contribution to charities and kids. He asked us to make a #b#t4001181##k for him. I want you to be flawless in making it.

no.0: I thought chutzpah comes from bravery, but I guess that's not the case.

1.0: I guess you really worked hard at this one, seeing that it's quite well-made. This is good, but I don't want this kind of work once every ten requests or so. True pros do this every time up. Don't you think? Anyway, good work there.

item.0: I thought I told you this was an important request. It's Cliff that made a request for #b#t4001181##k. Ahh, NOW YOU REMEMBER.

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
